description: Bus stops for Melbourne Visitor Shuttle is a dataset listed in City of Melbourne Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. The Melbourne Visitor Shuttle service started in March 2006 and was discontinued on 31 August 2017. It provided visitors with a route around the City with 13 stops at significant points of interest. Their descriptions and locations are maintained within this dataset. Coverage: City of Melbourne. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are accessibility, bus, entrepreneur, eventsplanner, melbourne visitor shuttle, tourist. The portal shows 13 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-10-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melbourne-vic-gov-au-portal.
